card.name: The word Intermediate as a middle level
card.fires_on: The word "intermediate" (capitalized or not) when it names a middle level or stage between two others, often after a list comma, "an", or "long- or".

modes.label: Middle of a scale
modes.description: "Intermediate" names the middle point between low and high, or between start and end.

modes.label: Middle item in a list
modes.description: "Intermediate" is one entry in a series, such as a size, stage or species name.
